# Exceptions to .github/scripts/check_game_files.py: files the check would flag that are this repository's
# own, not made from a game or the PS3 firmware. One glob per line, matched against the path from the
# repository root ("*" also crosses folders), each with a comment saying what the file is.

# SPU programs the runtime's tests generate (runtime/spu/tests/gen_test_*.py), lifted by tools/spu_lifter.py.
runtime/spu/tests/out_*/*
# The lifter's conformance driver: synthetic instruction cases, lifted by tools/test_ppu_lift.py.
scratch/ppu_conformance.cpp
# ps3recomp's own application icon.
packaging/macos/icon_1024.png
# SMAA's reference shader (iryoku/smaa, MIT), vendored as published for the D3D12 backend's RSX_AA=2 pass.
third_party/smaa/SMAA.hlsl
# The Vulkan backend's test shaders, written for test_gpu_vk.c; test_gpu_vk_spv.h holds them compiled.
libs/video/tests/test_gpu_vk_shaders.hlsl
